description: This file contains the implementation of the ImmutablePolicyBuilder class, a builder pattern implementation for constructing ImmutablePolicy objects with fluent API methods. It includes methods for setting policy attributes, managing subjects, resources, permissions, and building the final immutable policy object.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyBuilder
classes.description: A mutable builder class for creating ImmutablePolicy instances, implementing a fluent API to set policy details, subjects, resources, and permissions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new empty builder instance.

methods.name: of (PolicyId id)
methods.description: Creates a new builder initialized with a specific PolicyId.

methods.name: of (Policy existingPolicy)
methods.description: Creates a builder pre-filled with data from an existing Policy.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the PolicyId for the policy being built.

methods.name: setLifecycle
methods.description: Sets the lifecycle information for the policy.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Sets the revision information for the policy.

methods.name: setModified
methods.description: Sets the 'modified' timestamp.

methods.name: setCreated
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Adds a PolicyEntry to the builder.

methods.name: setPolicyEntry
methods.description: Internal method to process and store a PolicyEntry.

methods.name: putAllSubjects
methods.description: Stores all subjects from a PolicyEntry.

methods.name: setAll
methods.description: Sets multiple PolicyEntries at once.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes PolicyEntries associated with a specific label.

methods.name: removePolicyEntryFor
methods.description: Internal method to remove data associated with a label.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets subjects for a specific label.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a specific subject for a label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a subject for a label, either by issuerWithId or Subject object.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets resources and permissions for a label.

methods.name: retrieveExistingSubjects
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve or create subject map for a label.

methods.name: retrieveGrantedPermissions
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve granted permissions map for a label.

methods.name: retrieveRevokedPermissions
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve revoked permissions map for a label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a single resource for a label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes a resource or resource key from a label.

methods.name: setPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets granted and revoked permissions for a resource under a label.

methods.name: setGrantedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets only granted permissions for a resource.

methods.name: setRevokedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets only revoked permissions for a resource.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns the final immutable Policy object.
